```{r}
# Create Q-Q plots

qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model))

# Create Res vs Fit plots - interactive

create.res.vs.fit.ecosystems(model,
                             data_for_analysis)

# Create Res vs Fit plots - non interactive

fitted_values <- fitted(model)
residuals_values <- resid(model)

plot(fitted_values, residuals_values,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs. Fitted Values")

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

loess_fit <- loess(residuals_values ~ fitted_values)
lines(fitted_values[order(fitted_values)],
      predict(loess_fit)[order(fitted_values)],
      col = "blue",
      lwd = 2)

# Plot residuals spread by trophic type

data_for_analysis$residuals <- residuals(model)
data_for_analysis$fitted <- fitted(model)
ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(trophic_type), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Trophic Type", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by Trophic Type")

# Plot residuals spread by connection

ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(connection), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Connection", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by connection")

# Plot residuals spread by day

ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(day), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by Day")

# Plot residuals spread by disturbance percentage

ggplot(data_for_analysis, aes(x = factor(dis_per), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Disturbance percentage", y = "Residuals", title = "Residuals by disturbance percentage")

# Check zero inflation

calculate_total_zeros <- function(data, factor_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by(!!rlang::sym(factor_var)) %>%  # Group by the specified factor
    summarise(num_zeros = sum(bioarea_mm2_per_ml == 0), .groups = "drop")  # Count zeros
}

total_zeros_size <- calculate_total_zeros(data_for_analysis, "size")
total_zeros_size$size <- factor(total_zeros_size$size, levels = c(6.43, 9, 15, 45))
total_zeros_conn <- calculate_total_zeros(data_for_analysis, "conn")
total_zeros_dis_per <- calculate_total_zeros(data_for_analysis, "dis_per")
total_zeros_trophic <- calculate_total_zeros(data_for_analysis, "trophic_type")

ggplot(total_zeros_day, aes(x = day, y = num_zeros, fill = day)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Day", 
       y = "Total Number of Zeros") +
  theme_minimal() 

ggplot(total_zeros_size, 
       aes(x = as.factor(size), 
           y = num_zeros, 
           fill = as.factor(size))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Size", 
       y = "Total Number of Zeros") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Size")

ggplot(total_zeros_conn, 
       aes(x = as.factor(conn), 
           y = num_zeros, 
           fill = as.factor(conn))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Conn", 
       y = "Total Number of Zeros") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Conn")

ggplot(total_zeros_dis_per, 
       aes(x = as.factor(dis_per), 
           y = num_zeros, 
           fill = as.factor(dis_per))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Dis_per", 
       y = "Total Number of Zeros") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Dis_per")

ggplot(total_zeros_trophic, 
       aes(x = trophic_type, 
           y = num_zeros, 
           fill = trophic_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Total Number of Zeros in bioarea_mm2_per_ml by Trophic Type", 
       x = "Trophic Type", 
       y = "Total Number of Zeros") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Trophic Type")
```
